findings.title: Presentation order changes decisions but not stated beliefs
findings.claim: Across 36 matched same-fact pairs (6 cells x 6 seeds), Mercury-2.5's elicited posterior is identical in both presentation orders in every trial (0/36 belief flips), yet the terminal answer flips in 5/36 pairs (all 5 are correctness flips) and diagnostic choices diverge in 17/36 pairs.
findings.uncertainty: Small sample (36 pairs); no confidence interval computed; single model/provider.
alternatives: Presentation may affect parsing rather than decision; order effects may be seed-specific.
findings.falsifier: A replication with larger seed count showing zero terminal flips.
findings.prior_work: Consistent with order-sensitivity of LLM decisions reported in prior work; distinct in isolating belief invariance.
findings.followup: Increase seeds; add belief-elicitation controls; test other models.

findings.title: Proxy-channel interventions sharply reduce pass rates
findings.claim: Intervention cases introducing a visible_proxy or reward_proxy channel pass at 0.30 (8/27) and 0.25 (1/4) respectively, versus 0.69 base pass rate (228/331 scored base cases). Within paired groups sharing a latent spec, 7 of 76 intervention cases flip a passing base case to FAIL, 4 of which are visible_proxy.
findings.denominator: 27 visible_proxy cases; 4 reward_proxy cases; 76 intervention cases with a base in pair
findings.uncertainty: Intervention cases differ in difficulty levels; not a fully controlled manipulation.
alternatives: Difficulty confounding; proxy cases may be intrinsically harder.
findings.falsifier: A difficulty-matched re-run showing no proxy effect.
findings.prior_work: Relates to shortcut learning / proxy gaming in code-generation benchmarks.

findings.title: Exact posterior match on all epistemic-game variants
findings.claim: All 23 epistemic_games cases (base + evidence/presentation/prior interventions) achieve zero posterior error and correct verdict; posterior_reported equals posterior_true in every case.
findings.uncertainty: Compile-only? No, behavioral_reference guarantee for all 23.
alternatives: Tasks may be within training distribution; exact-match oracle may be lenient.
findings.falsifier: Harder epistemic instances with nonzero posterior error.
findings.prior_work: Consistent with LLM Bayesian updating on explicit likelihoods.

findings.title: Overall campaign pass rate with strong environment heterogeneity
findings.claim: Of 405 scored cases, 277 PASS and 128 FAIL (0.684). Pass rates range from 0.00 (glyph, functorial_augmentation, monadic_reward, sheaf_*, ts_one_step, ts_trajectory, epistemic_silence/type_games unscored) to 1.00 (categorical_lenses, ci_dependency_graph, css_state_machine, epistemic_games, etc.).
findings.uncertainty: Mixed judge guarantees (behavioral_reference vs compile_only); not a single benchmark score.
findings.prior_work: Benchmark-style aggregate; not a novel claim.

findings.title: Infrastructure gaps: 11 unscored cases and unverified twin groups
findings.claim: 11 cases are infrastructure_unscored (6 epistemic_silence, 4 epistemic_type_games, 1 rd_adaptive_halting). Twin verification status is unverified (56 of 132 twin cases unverified).

findings.title: Bimodal environment difficulty
findings.claim: Pass rates across 38 environments are bimodal: 10 environments score 0.00 (glyph, functorial_augmentation, monadic_reward, sheaf_invariant_gluing, sheaf_physical_constraints, ts_one_step, ts_trajectory, plus 3 unscored-only environments) and ~12 score 1.00 (categorical_lenses, ci_dependency_graph, css_state_machine, epistemic_games, rd_gradient_credit, rd_state_carry, semiring_unification, spreadsheet_dataflow, stochastic_monad, template_interpreter, tokenizer_adjunction, ts_parse_only, neuro_symbolic_parser, epistemic_announcements, epistemic_fragmented_observation, epistemic_nested_knowledge).
alternatives: Difficulty labels may be mis-calibrated per environment.
findings.falsifier: A second model showing different environment ordering.

findings.title: Failure modes dominated by underfit and visible-test overfit
findings.claim: Of 128 FAIL verdicts, 51 are underfit and 49 are overfit_visible_tests; source_invalid 9, runtime_error 11, invalid_action 5, training_failed 3.
findings.uncertainty: Labels are judge-assigned; overfit_visible_tests cases often have missing required files.
alternatives: Label semantics may not match failure cause.

findings.title: Non-monotonic difficulty transitions
findings.claim: Several environments show non-monotonic outcomes across difficulty levels: MoCo visible-test levels yield pass/fail/pass; CSS easy-surface cases yield partial/source-invalid/pass; SQL easy-surface passes at lengths 6 and 25 but source-invalid at 12.
findings.uncertainty: Single seed per cell; no replication.

findings.title: Proxy interventions reduce pass rates
findings.claim: visible_proxy 8/27 (0.30), reward_proxy 1/4 (0.25) vs base 228/331 (0.69); 7 pass->fail flips within shared latent specs.
